# Cardzy: Digital Wish Cards, Event Invitations & Smart vCards

> Cardzy is a global web application for creating interactive, animated 3D digital wish cards, multi-event invitation websites with WhatsApp RSVP tracking, Google Maps integration, live countdown timers, and executive smart digital business cards (vCards) across 18 international languages.
> Comprehensive bundled text library: https://cardzy.online/llms-full.txt

## Key Pages & Tools

- [Cardzy Homepage](https://cardzy.online): Create animated digital wish cards and full event invitation websites.
- [Create Digital Wish Card](https://cardzy.online/create-wish): Create custom 3D animated greeting cards for Eid, Birthdays, Anniversaries, and 34+ celebratory occasions.
- [Create Event Invitation Website](https://cardzy.online/create-invitation): Build royal invitation websites for Shaadi, Mehndi, Baraat, Walima, Nikkah, and corporate events with automated WhatsApp RSVP tracking.
- [Create Digital Visiting Card](https://cardzy.online/create-visiting-card): Executive digital business cards with 1-click contact save (.vcf), QR codes, and custom branding.
- [Eid Mubarak Cards & Invitations](https://cardzy.online/eid-mubarak-cards): Specialized Ramadan & Eid Mubarak animated cards with Urdu Nastaliq & Arabic typography.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://cardzy.online/pricing): View Free ($0 / PKR 0 forever), Pro ($4 / PKR 1,100/mo), and Business ($18 / PKR 5,000/mo) tiers.
- [Celebration Guides & Help Center](https://cardzy.online/guide): Event planning guides, Pakistani wedding invitation etiquette, and wording templates.
- [FAQ](https://cardzy.online/faq): Frequently asked questions about digital cards, RSVP tracking, payments (EasyPaisa, JazzCash, Cards), and custom domain links.
- [Editorial Team & Authors](https://cardzy.online/authors): Cultural stylists, technology strategists, and creative editors behind Cardzy.

## Core Capabilities

- **3D Animated Card Opening**: Realistic envelope unboxing animations with custom background music, confetti, and floating particles.
- **Multilingual Support (18 Languages)**: English, Urdu (اردو with Nastaliq font), Arabic (العربية), Spanish, French, Hindi, Chinese, Portuguese, Russian, German, Japanese, Korean, Italian, Turkish, Indonesian, Bengali, Vietnamese, and Swahili.
- **Interactive Event Features**: 1-click WhatsApp RSVP management, live countdown timers, Google Maps venue navigation pins, dress code notes, and gift registry links.
- **Paperless Visiting Cards (vCards)**: Instant .vcf contact saving, dynamic QR codes, portfolio links, and social links with zero paper waste.
- **Instant Digital Delivery**: Share via WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Instagram, or download high-resolution PNG image cards.
